entities.summary: Pier Giacomo Grampa is a Swiss‑Italian prelate of the Roman Catholic Church who served as the bishop of the Diocese of Lugano in Switzerland from 2003 until his retirement in 2013. Upon retiring, he became bishop emeritus of Lugano.
